Hi Alicia —

Quick technical notes ahead of the intake call so your security team has context: 

- Encryption: all customer data in Hosted API is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit via TLS1.3. We use KMS-backed keys; for Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed keys (CMK).
- Logging & PHI: application logs are redacted by default; access to raw logs is limited and audited. If you need PHI in logs for debugging we recommend a controlled escalation and short retention window.
- Networking: Hosted API endpoints are in our multi-region clusters; we can provide an IP allowlist and CIDR ranges. For Private deployments we support VPC peering and private egress.

I attached a stub network diagram to show typical network paths (network-architecture-diagram-stub.png). We'll bring a fuller architecture diagram to the intake call (requires NDA).

I'll also prepare an evidence checklist mapping the questionnaire items to the artifacts you can expect (SOC 2 report, controls mapping, encryption whitepaper, network diagram).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
